state.payload: raw webhook body (str|bytes) — parsed + signature-verified by the organ
state.event: pre-parsed event dict (caller asserts it already verified; signature check skipped)

context.webhook_secret: AIRWALLEX_WEBHOOK_SECRET (empty selects the unverified fall-through path)
context.price_ids: map of plan name -> Airwallex price_id

output_ports.record_unverified_audit: bool — caller must write the security_review audit row

purity: stdlib-only (hmac, hashlib, json, typing); deterministic; no I/O
